author: Cool Worlds
description:
A video essay on what worries me most about AI. Like so many of the big issues in our lives, it's not a black-and-white good-vs-evil dichotomy. Although it's certainly a powerful and amazing tool in many use cases, something I often use myself with great wonder (e.g. we often use AI to upscale grainy clips), I fear its irresponsible (and perhaps unavoidable) exploitation may push us into an intellectual dark age.

This is an unsponsored video. It was not commissioned, supported or prompted by outside agencies in any way. Written, presented and edited by David Kipping.
